title: Sensus Healthcare Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Business Highlights
summary: Sensus Healthcare Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Business Highlights - Sensus Healthcare -
body_markdown:
*Commercial Momentum Builds with Broader Physician Engagement and Customer Adoption*


*New Dermatology Group Relationships Support Customer Expansion and Diversification Strategy*


*Increasing Patient Awareness and International Commercial Activities Create Additional Growth Opportunities*


BOCA RATON, Fla. –


Sensus Healthcare, Inc. (Nasdaq: SRTS), a medical device company committed to providing highly effective, non-invasive treatments for oncological and non-oncological skin conditions, today announced financial results and business highlights for the three months ended September 30, 2026.


**Highlights included:**


- Revenues of $6.0 million compared with $6.9 million in the third quarter of 2025, reflecting a product mix of lower-priced SRT-100 systems and the absence of sales to a historically large customer.


- Gross profit increased to $3.3 million from $2.7 million in the third quarter of 2025 and gross margin improved to 55% from 39.1% in the prior-year period.


- Shipped 26 systems, including eight carried over from the second quarter of 2026 due to financing approval timing, compared with 16 in the prior-year period. Excluding those eight systems, 18 systems were shipped during the quarter, compared with six shipments to customers other than the Company’s historically largest customer in the third quarter of 2025.


- Continued physician education initiatives and expanded customer relationships, including initial system purchases by two large private equity-backed dermatology groups.


- Launched[TreatSkinCancer.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftreatskincancer.com%2F&esheet=54640503&newsitemid=20261112617659&lan=en-US&anchor=TreatSkinCancer.com&index=1&md5=d372f270470a07c14753a17a3eb85338) , a consumer education resource designed to increase awareness of skin cancer treatment options, complementing the Company’s ongoing physician education initiatives.


- Advanced international market-development activities across Asia-Pacific, including Australia, New Zealand, China and Hong Kong.


- Subsequent to quarter end, placed the Company’s 1,000th SRT system, marking an important commercial milestone.


**Management Commentary**


“Our third quarter results reflect continued progress in building a broader, more diversified customer base and advancing our business toward sustainable profitability,” said Joseph Sardano, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. “With dedicated reimbursement codes now in effect, our conversations with physicians are increasingly focused on how to bring SRT into their practices.


“Our vision is to make SRT a more widely understood and accessible non-invasive treatment option for appropriate patients with non-melanoma skin cancer. We are expanding physician education and patient awareness, including through[TreatSkinCancer.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftreatskincancer.com%2F&esheet=54640503&newsitemid=20261112617659&lan=en-US&anchor=TreatSkinCancer.com&index=2&md5=7dcd62b7520c77886c3f1502ab234725) , while pursuing opportunities internationally and developing additional revenue streams tied to system utilization, software and services. The recent sale of our 1,000th SRT system is a milestone I am particularly proud of.


“We have spent years advancing the technology and growing our installed base. Today, we have a reimbursement framework that we believe can support broader adoption and a more scalable business. Our focus is on converting these opportunities into sales, increasing utilization and building a more diversified, sustainably profitable business,” concluded Sardano.


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results**


Revenues were $6.0 million compared with $6.9 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, a decrease of $0.9 million, or 13.0%. The revenue decrease primarily reflected a shift in product mix toward lower-priced SRT-100 systems versus higher-priced SRT-100 Vision systems, resulting in a lower average selling price per unit, as well as the absence of sales to a historically large customer. In addition, three systems shipped during the quarter were under the Fair Deal Agreement program and rental arrangements compared to zero in the prior year period, for which revenue is recognized over the term of the agreement rather than at the time of shipment.


Unit shipments increased year-over-year to 26 systems, including eight carried over from the second quarter of 2026, compared with 16 systems in the prior-year period.


Cost of sales was $2.7 million compared to $4.2 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, a decrease of $1.5 million, or 35.7%. The decrease in cost of sales was primarily related to the product mix, including a higher proportion of SRT-100 units shipped compared to SRT-100 Vision units shipped, as SRT-100 units have a lower average cost per unit.


Gross profit was $3.3 million compared to $2.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, an increase of $0.6 million, or 22.2%. Overall gross profit percentage was 55%, compared to 39.1% in the corresponding period in 2025. The increase in gross profit and margin was primarily driven by product mix, including a higher proportion of shipments of higher-margin SRT-100 units compared to lower-margin SRT-100 Vision units.


General and administrative expense was $2.3 million compared to $1.9 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, an increase of $0.4 million, or 21.1%. The net increase in general and administrative expense was primarily due to higher legal and professional fees offset by reduction of insurance cost.


Selling and marketing expense was $1.5 million, flat with the third quarter of 2025.


Research and development expense was $1.1 million compared to $1.8 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, a decrease of $0.7 million, or 38.9%. The decrease was primarily due to a reduction in lobbying cost and reduced headcount.


Other income of $0.1 million and $0.2 million for the quarters ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, relates primarily to interest income.


Net loss was $1.5 million, or $0.09 per share, compared with net loss of $0.9 million, or $0.06 per share, for the three months ended September 30, 2025.


Adjusted EBITDA was a negative $1.5 million, compared with negative $2.4 million for the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP financial measure, is defined as earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization and stock-compensation expense. Please see below for a reconciliation between GAAP and non-GAAP financial measures, and the reasons these non-GAAP financial measures are provided.


Cash, restricted cash and cash equivalents were $12.9 million as of September 30, 2026, compared with $15.2 million as of June 30, 2026. The Company had no outstanding borrowings under its revolving line of credit at September 30, 2026. Prepaid inventory was zero compared with $0.6 million as of June 30, 2026. Inventories were $18.0 million compared with $18.5 million as of June 30, 2026.

**About Sensus Healthcare**


Sensus Healthcare, Inc. is a global pioneer in the development and delivery of non-invasive treatments for skin cancer and keloids. Leveraging its cutting-edge superficial radiotherapy (SRT and IG-SRT) technology, the company provides healthcare providers with a highly effective, patient-centric treatment platform. With a dedication to driving innovation in radiation oncology, Sensus Healthcare offers solutions that are safe, precise, and adaptable to a variety of clinical settings. For more information, please visit[www.sensushealthcare.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.globenewswire.com%2FTracker%3Fdata%3Dl3EOQq7j2fQTT4NpMM9H4P0kN1o4i0ToQLN3C0ECMOuqSNOvKoDT-t4_aMG6v4KpQi2s-QisBjHSejH6og_b9n8b-GTZ3HS8ln0zrP5lzEc%3D&esheet=54640503&newsitemid=20261112617659&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sensushealthcare.com&index=6&md5=feb306db94b7bf7fdd6cbdce45d5f619) .
